episodes.title: 257: The Twelve Tribes
episodes.description: A charming little deli. A religious commune. Some extremely concerning beliefs. And suddenly that sandwich has a LOT of baggage. This week on Cursewords and Crayons, we're talking about The Twelve Tribes—the religious group behind the cozy, rustic Yellow Deli restaurants that are still operating today. Nothing says “let's grab a cute little sandwich” quite like discovering you have accidentally wandered into a cult rabbit hole. 💬 Come yell with us on Instagram. Send us your case suggestions, theories, voice memos, and—most importantly—tell us if you've ever actually eaten at a Yellow Deli. 👻 Follow the chaos: Instagram: @cursewordsandcrayons Zee: @mrs.zette Amy: @amyrehsdupin

episodes.title: Episode 199: Relaunch of the Blackburn Cult (Episode 48)
episodes.description: Another day another horror. It’s time for an episode of Cursewords and Crayons! A podcast where we talk about True Crime (and sometimes parenting), reminding everyone that it's what is on the inside that counts and sometimes the inside is just as rotten as the outside. This week we are kicking it back to episode 48 and talking about The Blackburn Cult. Lots of speculating, lots of whacky people, a lot of drams.
